title: Addition preserves summed component labels
statement: For any schemes T,U, abelian group E small in the scheme universe, s:U→T and two points f,g over s, if f(x) lies in component e and g(x) in component e′, their scheme-theoretic sum at x lies in component e+e′.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Remark 59.23.2 (Tag 03P5), using Groupoids, Example 39.5.6 (Tag 03YW) for the constant group scheme and its decomposition into copies of the base

proof.text: Pair f and g into the fibre square. The pullback open-cover chart indexed by (e,e') contains the paired point by the pullback range formula. The defining restriction equation for the multiplication on this chart identifies its image with the coprojection indexed by e+e'. Unfolding the point sum gives the claimed component membership.

proof_origin.place: Schemes, Lemma 26.14.1 (Tag 01JB, lemma-glue), mapping properties for the glueing data of a disjoint union (the source omits their proof), together with Groupoids, Example 39.5.6 (Tag 03YW) for the constant group scheme and its multiplication and Etale Cohomology, Remark 59.23.2 (Tag 03P5); the Stacks project states the correspondence without proof, the steps are written by the worker

lean.statement:
theorem constantGroupSchemePointAdd_component (T U : Scheme.{u}) (E : Type v)
    [Small.{u} E] [AddCommGroup E] (s : U ⟶ T)
    (f g : ConstantGroupSchemePoint T E s) (x : U) (e e' : E)
    (hf : f.1 x ∈ constantGroupSchemeComponent T E e)
    (hg : g.1 x ∈ constantGroupSchemeComponent T E e') :
    (constantGroupSchemePointAdd T E s f g).1 x ∈
      constantGroupSchemeComponent T E (e + e')
